en:
No, it wasn't possible to kill her
the moment the cage was lifted.

Because the <CLT=cltSTRONG>inside of the white cloth<CLT=cltNORMAL>
had Tenko's blood on it!

That cloth was removed
before the cage was lifted.

If Tenko was stabbed then, there wouldn't
be blood on the cloth.

What? But...how could my golden brain
be wrong when it felt so, so right?

The only possibility is that Tenko was
killed during the seance—

No, it's still wrong to think that Tenko
was killed during the seance.

I'm gonna prove it right now...
My golden brain is gonna go all out!
